claim.statement: The observed CI, runtime, and backup results are properties of the target repository/system rather than environment and investigation state.

problem.statement: Determine why verification results differ across local, clean-main, CI, self-hosted, and restored environments.

boundary.declared: msb-v3 code and tests under evaluation
boundary.actual: code + git checkout state + optional dependencies + environment variables + supervisor topology + repository config + backup semantics + investigation actions

violations.effect: tracked artifacts were omitted from restored copy

result.observed: different tests, collections, endpoint states, and restore results across environments

drift_evidence: server ownership changed during supervisor conflict
backup restore semantics differed from live tracked tree

assumptions.statement: A clean local test result and a CI test result are directly comparable.
The investigation can use scratch worktrees without affecting repository-wide state.

failure.description: The investigation initially treated environment-dependent verification differences as properties of the software under test.
failure.evidence: Changing checkout history, optional dependency availability, environment variables, supervisor topology, repository configuration, and restore semantics changed observed outcomes.

inversion.apparent_axiom: A failing test identifies a defect in the target system.
inversion.inverted_axiom: A failing test may identify an environment, measurement, or investigation defect instead.
competing_explanations: The test environment changes the measurement.
The verifier inherits configuration from the execution environment.
The investigation itself changes the state being measured.

candidate_controls.name: environment provenance preflight
candidate_controls.reusable_test: capture checkout depth, environment variables, optional package set, process topology, repository config scope, and restore semantics before measurement

candidate_controls.name: observer mutation firewall
candidate_controls.reusable_test: disallow investigation-side mutation of measured environments unless isolated, authorized, and recorded

candidate_controls.name: measurement-context lock
candidate_controls.reusable_test: freeze and fingerprint measurement-affecting environment state before baseline and before verdict

new_questions: Which environment variables can change the semantics of the measurement itself?
Which repository-scoped settings cross worktree boundaries?
Can the observer mutate the system under test during investigation?
What process topology can alter availability or ownership independently of code?
Which restore operations preserve tracked semantics rather than merely file presence?
What other variables are not represented in the current verification taxonomy?
